verdicts.why: Simmons operates on Yo-Yo in S5E11 and she and Mack graft the prosthetic arms on in S5E15, so the whole text is true from S5#15.

split.on_b_card_about_a: Friend May takes to Afterlife and helps win back her powers.

A season-level title means the end of S7, which is later than now, and the friendship does not start there. Enoch's time with the team ends with his death in S7E9, so S7#9 already covers the whole text.
In Slingshot episode 2 'John Hancock' Yo-Yo signs the Accords, Mace warns her about Ross and the Raft, and she steals his access card to look for Ramon.
Enoch heals May in the Healing Pod in S7E1 and draws an I.C.E.R. on her in S7E2, so the stage belongs at S7#2. The season-level title proposed would mean the end of S7, which is even later than #9.
Their closeness peaks in S7E9, where Coulson stays with Enoch as he dies, so S7#9 fits. A season-level title means the end of S7, which is later, not where the relationship starts.
Nadeer blackmails Mace into sending Simmons on the secret mission to help Vijay through Terrigenesis in S4E7.
The Superior's order to execute Vijay, and Nadeer shooting him, are both S4E9 'Broken Promises'.
In 'BOOM' (S4E13) the Superior sends Shockley with a Terrigen Crystal to test Nadeer, and the blast from Shockley's own Terrigenesis kills her.
Nadeer never refuses to kill Vijay. She shoots him herself in S4E9, and in S4E13 Shockley smashes a crystal to expose her but transforms himself, and his explosion kills her.
Shockley first appears in S4E9, leading Nadeer's Watchdogs against Vijay. He is furious when she spares him, and after she shoots Vijay she tells Shockley never to threaten her again.

In S1E9 a junkie paid by Fisk's men stabs Elena, and Matt tracks him down, which leads into the Hand ambush.

value.text: Years later, a Gamora from another time joins the Guardians' mission to save Rocket. Kraglin stays behind on Knowhere, then flies it into battle against the High Evolutionary's ship and locks the two together so everyone can escape.
